name: Atlantic South Equatorial Undercurrent
scope: Declared western-to-central Atlantic subsurface reach from the 35 W section near 3 S to an OSW truncation near 10 W, 4.3 S. Uses the published float-study domain, not full-current start and termination. Excludes westward SEC legs, NBUC source pathways, recirculation loops, surface drift and uncertain central/eastern continuation.
layer: Subsurface eastward flow in the context of floats parked at 200 m. The 200 m level is sampling support, not a uniform core depth or full vertical extent. Ship-section 100–500 m and density-defined transport integrations are separate diagnostics.
time_convention: Float deployments in 2000–2004 and 2004–2006; ship-section composites span 1990–2008. Editorial geographic reach is not one observed float trajectory, dated axis, annual mean or seasonal series.
source_locator: Section 2 [6]–[7] and Fig. 1: floats parked at 200 m; 174 ten-day zonal-flow estimates within 3–6 S, 35 W to approximately 10 W. Section 4 [9]: mean core around 3 S at 35 W and slightly south of 4 S farther east. Sections 5–6: western meanders and unresolved layer-dependent connectivity.
source_citation: Fischer, Hormann, Brandt, Schott, Rabe and Funk (2008), South Equatorial Undercurrent in the western to central tropical Atlantic, Geophysical Research Letters 35, doi:10.1029/2008GL035753.
source_license: Publisher free-access article, no open reuse license inferred. Attributed regional facts paraphrased; no figures, float curves or observed fields copied.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects rounded waypoints between the source section and float-domain longitudes, using the mean-core latitude context around 3 S at 35 W and slightly south of 4 S eastward. The 10 W latitude is editorial. Smooth bends test a regional reference path, not the documented western standing-wave shape, individual float excursions or recirculation. No source trajectory or velocity contour digitized.

alternative_routes.interpretation: OSW northern smooth reference bend with an earlier study truncation; not an observed seasonal axis or width edge.
OSW southern smooth bend and later study truncation; no individual float loop or actual western standing wave reconstructed.

scenario_rule: Three declared reach shapes crossed with uniform longitude shifts -0.25/0/+0.25 degrees and independent endpoint latitude shifts -0.25/0/+0.25 degrees: 81 editorial cases, not physical width, seasonal variation or statistical confidence.
remaining_gates: Review gates, western meanders and chosen core-latitude smoothing with compatible velocity or trajectory data.
Resolve the eastern rise and fate before whole-current endpoints; 10 W is study truncation.
Separate 200 m float sampling from ship-section depth/density transport definitions and surface drift.
Diagnose paired lateral boundaries before width; 3–6 S is a sampling band, not full-current width.
